examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

уезжать.gloss: to leave, to go away (by vehicle)

meanings.en: to leave, go away, depart (by transport)
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'езжать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to leave, to go away (by vehicle)', paired with 'уехать'.

examples.text: Уезжай с Алёшей на шесть месяцев.
examples.trans: Go away with Alyosha for six months.

examples.text: Уезжай с Алёшей на шесть месяцев. И все всё забудут!
examples.trans: Go away with Alyosha for six months. And everyone will forget everything!

examples.text: Я уезжаю сегодня навсегда из города.
examples.trans: I am leaving the city forever today.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'later' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Go on, come by later! Later!

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: polite formula, at a door or before asking something

examples.trans: May we come in? Good day, sir.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ъяснить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to explain', paired with 'объяснять'.

examples.trans: I will explain everything to you right now.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: to run (in various directions or habitually)
meanings.note: вокруг меня бегала = she was running after me

examples.trans: The children are running around in the yard.

examples.text: Это она со мной познакомилась! Вокруг меня бегала.
examples.trans: She was the one who came up to me! She was running after me.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: + accusative: через неделю = in a week

examples.text: Нормально? Она через неделю снова потечёт!
examples.trans: Fine? It'll be leaking again in a week!
We give him three days. That's it.
When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

прилететь.gloss: to arrive (by air), to fly in

meanings.en: to arrive by plane, to fly in
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'лететь'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to arrive (by air), to fly in', paired with 'прилетать'.

examples.trans: We flew in for the deal.

examples.text: Мы сюда зачем прилетели? Я сразу сказал: с ним ничего не получится.
examples.trans: What did we even fly out here for? I said from the start: nothing will come of it with him.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to bring (carrying)', paired with 'приносить'.

examples.trans: What did you bring into the flat?

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'навидеть'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to hate', paired with 'возненавидеть'.

examples.text: Скажи мне в глаза. За что ты меня так ненавидишь?
examples.trans: Say it to my face. Why do you hate me so much?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

examples.text: Чёрт, я запутался. Это опасная идея.
examples.trans: Darn, I am confused. This is a dangerous idea.
What on earth kind of acclimatization?!

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

examples.text: Я из-за тебя не полетела в Милан!
examples.trans: I missed the Milan trip because of you!
Tomorrow we will fly to rest, okay?

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лететь'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fly, to start flying'.
Core Russian name meaning 'Milan' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Я из-за тебя не полетела в Милан!
examples.trans: I missed the Milan trip because of you!
